verified: A public GitHub repository named lsernau/grh-lean exists and is presented on Hacker News as a much shorter community version of Anthropic's GRH Lean formal verification, with commenters describing human-readable documentation and a split between "known math" and "new math".
unconfirmed: The exact reduction — commenters cite roughly 17 million lines down to about 76,000 (99.56%), while another refers to a "300kloc" proof — and whether the compact proof compiles, proves the same theorem as the original, or was produced by Anthropic applying internal models over a few days.

verified: Hacker News 上出现一条提交，指向 lsernau 的 GitHub 仓库 grh-lean，并将其描述为 Anthropic GRH Lean 验证的“短得多”的版本；仓库和讨论链接可公开访问。
unconfirmed: 约 1700 万行降至约 7.6 万行、99.56% 降幅、300kloc 的可读版本、“已知数学/新数学”分区与文档，均来自评论者，未获独立核验；评论中 300kloc 与约 7.6 万行两种规模说法也未对齐。Anthropic 是否认可该版本、证明是否完整、人类可读性究竟如何，均无官方说明。

titles.en: Community repo offers much shorter version of Anthropic's GRH Lean proof
titles.zh: Anthropic 的 GRH Lean 验证出现大幅精简社区版
